data.description:
Seed context: The Game Design Document (docs/Game Design Document.md) defines Level 3 (The Core) with both the **Wall** wave type ('dense horizontal line of enemies that advances slowly') and the **Dive Bomb** wave type ('enemies alternate between formation flight and diving toward the player'). The GDD does not state whether different enemy types can pass through each other. In particular: can the player shoot past the Wall to hit Dive Bombs behind it, and can a Dive Bomb dive through/past the Wall to attack (and thereby become exposed)? Enemy-to-enemy interaction rules need to be clarified in the GDD.

--priority medium (operator-specified)
